build.title: Start the launch
build.simple: If your site is not live yet, start here. Press Launch My Business. The system will ask you for four quick choices.
build.tip: You do not need technical knowledge. The system gives you buttons to choose from.

build.title: Choose your niche
build.simple: Pick the topic you want your website to focus on. Your niche guides the products and articles that the AI creates for your site.
build.tip: Choose the topic that feels most natural to you. You can simply click one of the options shown on screen.

build.title: Choose your business name
build.simple: After the niche is selected, the system suggests business names. Pick the name you like. It becomes your brand and part of your website address.
build.tip: You do not need to invent a name yourself unless the system offers that option. Pick one of the suggestions and continue.

build.title: Choose the look of your site
build.simple: First choose a design family. Then choose one theme inside that family. This controls the colors, style, and overall look of the website.
build.tip: There is no ‘correct’ design. Pick the style you like best.

build.title: Create your logo
build.simple: At the last setup step, choose Generate a Logo. The system creates logo options for the business name you selected.
build.tip: Click the logo you prefer. You can review it before the website goes live.

build.title: Review and launch
build.simple: Before launch, check the summary: niche, business name, website address, design, and logo. If everything looks right, press Launch My Business.
build.tip: If you want to change something, use Change answer / Start over before launching.

live.title: Your Dashboard — your home screen
live.simple: After your site is live, the Dashboard is your starting point. It gives you quick ways to visit the website, check results, add a payout method, view billing, boost traffic, and see upgrades.
live.tip: Press the + inside the message box to see every action you can take from the Dashboard, all in one list. You can also just type a normal question to the AI Assistant — you do not have to memorize commands.

live.title: Stats — understand what is happening
live.simple: Stats show the activity on your website. Impressions are views, Clicks are recorded clicks, and Revenue is the earnings calculated for the selected period.
live.tip: Estimated Website Value is not the same as withdrawable money. Your wallet and payout status are shown separately.

live.title: Payment method — tell us where to send payouts
live.simple: Add a payout method before you want to withdraw earnings. The current screen lets you choose PayPal, Wise, or Bank transfer.
live.tip: Enter the details carefully. You can update your payout method later if needed.

live.title: Billing & Wallet — earnings and available balance
live.simple: This area shows estimated revenue, your available balance, monthly breakdown, and money that is still in hold. It also gives access to daily earnings, past withdrawals, and payment method settings.
live.tip: Money can appear in your earnings before it becomes available to withdraw. Follow the payout timing and minimum threshold shown in the help information.

live.title: Free Traffic Boost — add a 24-hour traffic push
live.simple: The Free Traffic Boost lets you activate a 24-hour visitor boost. Press Boost for the website you want to boost. When the timer ends, you can activate the available boost again.
live.tip: The free 24-hour boost is different from paid 7-day, 14-day, or 30-day Traffic Boost packages.

live.title: Article Generator — add more content
live.simple: Your website starts with AI-generated comparison content. The Article Generator is the place where you can expand the site with additional articles when you choose to do so.
live.tip: More content gives the site more topics and pages to work with, but traffic or rankings are never guaranteed.

live.title: Paid Boosters & Upgrades — optional growth tools
live.simple: The Boosters and Upgrades areas show optional paid products such as traffic packages and article packs. These are separate from the free daily boost.
live.tip: You do not need to buy an upgrade just to keep your existing website live.

live.title: Purchase Billing — see what you bought
live.simple: The Billing page in the left menu shows invoices for add-ons you purchased and their status. This is different from your earnings wallet.
live.tip: Think of it this way: Purchase Billing = money you paid. Billing & Wallet in the assistant = money your website generated.

live.title: Support — view and manage tickets
live.simple: Open Support to see your requests and the team’s replies. You can see whether a ticket is in progress or closed and open a new request when needed.
live.tip: Refund requests always stay available as a direct Support request so they can be tracked from the beginning.
